purpose: Teach: 印紙/新法/極論/由緒/疑義/客員/総評/携え

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 契約書の印紙税を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we've checked the stamp tax on the contract.
lines.style: Clear and purposeful. Even pace, professional. Opens with quiet confidence. A task to move through together, not a demand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新法に対応した社内ルールを整備します
lines.en: Got it. I'll get our internal rules updated to align with the new regulations.
lines.style: Attentive and ready. Slight nod in the voice. Direct but not stiff — showing he's already thinking through the steps.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 極論で議論を進めるのは避けましょう
lines.en: Let's avoid pushing the discussion into extremes.
lines.style: Steady directorial tone. Not harsh, but clear intent. A gentle redirect — experienced enough to know where arguments can drift.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の由緒を社員に伝える研修をします
lines.en: Right. I'll set up a training session to walk the team through our company's background and values.
lines.style: Affirming and methodical. He's already mapping it out as he speaks. Warm enough to show he understands the 'why,' not just the task.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員からの疑義に丁寧に答えましょう
lines.en: And when staff members raise questions or concerns, let's address them thoughtfully.
lines.style: Measured, instructive. Slight emphasis on 'thoughtfully' — this matters. The voice of someone who knows rushed answers create more problems.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。客員講師の招聘を企画します
lines.en: Understood. I'll arrange for a guest speaker from the industry to come in and help explain it.
lines.style: Energetic agreement. He's already picturing the logistics. Efficient but warm — showing initiative without needing to be pushed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界誌の総評欄に当社の取り組みを載せましょう
lines.en: And let's get our approach highlighted in the industry magazine's review section.
lines.style: Ambitious but grounded. Eyes forward. The voice of someone building something worth talking about — not boastful, just purposeful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様のニーズを携えて商談に臨みます
lines.en: I'll go into client meetings with their needs front and center, ready to have real conversations.
lines.style: Warm closure. Settled and confident. The promise of someone who understands that good business comes from actually listening. Slight fade on the final phrase.
